name: Dhawa Ho Tram
short_description: A beachfront resort on a 6-hectare property in Ho Tram with all sea-view rooms, about two hours by car from Ho Chi Minh City.
ai_summary: Dhawa Ho Tram is a beachfront resort on a 6-hectare property in Ho Tram, roughly two hours by car from Ho Chi Minh City and within walking distance of Ho Tram Beach. Every room in the beachfront building has a sea view, and the resort includes Nook restaurant plus a seafood and pizza bar right on the beach, set within lush, landscaped grounds. Guest reviews are consistently strong, describing the resort as clean, quiet, and family-friendly with a big pool next to the beach, good food across its restaurants, and excellent customer service, though some reviews note occasional lapses in service quality and room maintenance that management has acknowledged.

faqs.question: How far is Dhawa Ho Tram from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.answer: About two hours by car, making it a popular weekend beach getaway for Ho Chi Minh City residents. The resort sits on a 6-hectare beachfront property within walking distance of Ho Tram Beach itself.

faqs.question: Do all rooms at Dhawa Ho Tram have sea views?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the beachfront hotel building is designed so every room overlooks the sea, and the resort adds Nook restaurant plus a dedicated seafood and pizza bar right on the beach for guests who want to eat without leaving the sand.
